items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: For instance, part of one semester my roommate was Milt Campbell

ctx.x: Ernst Hoffman said, “If you’re not going to serve him, you’re not going to serve anybody.” They were left with all those meals, and we got back on the bus. So it was kind of a – in that way, the official policy was that we couldn’t live in the dorms, so we lived in homes. Then I lived with the athletes. For instance, part of one semester my roommate was Milt Campbell, who won the decathlon in 19 – whenever the Olympics were.
’52 Olympics. [He won the silver medal in the 1952 Olympics and the gold medal in the 1956 Olympics.]
